title: Barcelona food tour.
text:
Very interesting experience. Etienne was a good guide. Very friendly and knowledgeable. Took only slightly more a than 1.5 hours which is way less than advertised. But still was a worthwhile. 
My only complaint/suggestion is that a food tour of Barcelona should include a visit to the food market by La Rambla. This tour didn’t do that.

author: 280charmainec

title: A must do walking food tour of Barcelona
text: What an exceptional afternoon. Our guide, Andrea, from “Do Eat Better Experience” was welcoming, knowledgeable, interesting and engaging. We strolled around the small laneways of the old gothic quarter of Barcelona and went to several small cafes and bars that the locals only seem to know about rather than the big tourist destinations. A three hour, but leisurely trip.  Lots of history and context wherever we went.
